description: Kujiondoa kwa kuelekezwa kwa CallerSmart, ambalo huorodhesha watu kwa nambari ya simu. Kujiondoa mara moja kunajumuisha kila nambari iliyohifadhiwa.
instructions: Fungua https://www.callersmart.com/data. For each of these numbers, enter the number and {contact_email}, finish the robot check, then type the 6-digit code CallerSmart texts or calls to that phone: {all_phones}. Kisha bonyeza "Nimefanya hili".
